== Description ==

Games in the hall at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025, with [[Justin Miyashiro]] (front left, black R2D2 shirt) playing a man in a grey long-sleeve shirt (unlabeled), and [[Karl Koenig]] (back left) vs [[Kyle Krueger]] (back right) at the next table.
